decisions.reason: The same message already records the Small Block interval as approximate, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
The existing message-184 MODIFY already updates the displayed Big Block interval to approximately 10,000 sales.
The existing message-184 MODIFY already describes the Big Block drawing as occurring about every 10,000 sales.
Making the Big Block sales interval approximate does not change when tickets are issued, their recipient, quantity, or lifecycle.
The approximate draw interval does not change the winner-selection method, eligible population, ticket weighting, or randomness provider.
The interval qualification does not alter allocation of no-referral tickets to a random existing NFT holder.
Separate Small and Big Block counters and their post-draw resets remain valid regardless of whether the Big Block interval is approximate.
The approximate sales interval does not change automatic prize delivery; the independent delivery change from message 184 is already recorded.
The source decision only qualifies the Big Block draw interval and neither resolves the existing Aave lifecycle ambiguity nor changes its yield behavior.
The approximate Big Block interval does not change mint price, founder or commission shares, or active prize-pool destinations.
The interval qualification does not change winner announcement or notification channels; the independent notification clause in message 184 is already recorded.
Making the draw interval approximate does not change which ticket counters, badges, or referral-code attributes appear in NFT metadata.
